All code is given except **two blanks**, marked `___`. Fill them in, knit, and

# Fetch 14 proteins from UniProt

Fourteen human proteins with known destinations. One request asks UniProt for
their signal peptide, transit peptide and transmembrane features, and their
sequence.

```{r proteins}
proteins <- data.frame(
  accession = c("P02768", "P01308", "Q8NBP7", "P11021", "P27824", "P07237",
                "P11279", "P04062", "P01130", "P02786", "P25705", "O75390",
                "P37198", "P04406"),
  destination = c("Secreted", "Secreted", "Secreted", "ER", "ER", "ER",
                  "Lysosome", "Lysosome", "Cell surface", "Cell surface",
                  "Mitochondrion", "Mitochondrion", "Nuclear pore", "Cytosol"))

uniprot_url <- paste0(
  "https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/accessions?accessions=",
  paste(proteins$accession, collapse = ","),
  "&fields=accession,gene_primary,ft_signal,ft_transit,ft_transmem,sequence",
  "&format=tsv")
```

```{r fetch}
read_snapshot <- function() {
  file <- if (file.exists(snapshot_file)) snapshot_file else snapshot_url
  data_source <<- "Course snapshot of UniProtKB"
  data_date <<- "2026-11-19"
  data_release <<- "2026_04"
  read.csv(file, check.names = FALSE, colClasses = "character")
}

if (use_snapshot) {
  raw <- read_snapshot()
} else {
  raw <- tryCatch({
    x <- read.delim(uniprot_url, check.names = FALSE, quote = "",
                    colClasses = "character")
    data_source <- "UniProtKB REST API"
    data_date <- as.character(Sys.Date())
    headers <- curlGetHeaders(uniprot_url)
    release <- grep("^x-uniprot-release:", headers, ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
    if (length(release) > 0) data_release <- trimws(sub("^[^:]*:", "", release[1]))
    x
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("UniProt unavailable, using the course snapshot")
    read_snapshot()
  })
}
```

# Make the feature table

Each feature column becomes TRUE (annotated) or FALSE (not annotated). The last
four residues come from the end of the sequence with `substr()`.

```{r features}
has_feature <- function(x) !is.na(x) & x != ""

features <- raw |>
  transmute(accession = Entry,
            gene = `Gene Names (primary)`,
            signal_peptide = has_feature(`Signal peptide`),
            transit_peptide = has_feature(`Transit peptide`),
            transmembrane = has_feature(Transmembrane),
            last_four = substr(Sequence, nchar(Sequence) - 3, nchar(Sequence))) |>
  left_join(proteins, by = "accession")

head(features, 3)
```

# Blank 1: which proteins end in KDEL?

Replace `___` with the four letters of the ER retrieval signal, in quotes.

```{r kdel}
features |>
  filter(last_four == "KDEL") |>
  select(gene, destination, last_four)
```

# Blank 2: a feature map

The table is reshaped to one row per protein and feature (given). Fill in the
`aes()` mapping: features on the x axis, genes on the y axis, and the fill
colour showing whether the feature is present. The column names are `feature`,
`gene` and `present`.

```{r long}
long <- bind_rows(lapply(
  c("signal_peptide", "transit_peptide", "transmembrane"),
  function(f) data.frame(gene = features$gene,
                         destination = features$destination,
                         feature = f,
                         present = features[[f]])))
```

```{r feature-map, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 7}
ggplot(long, aes(x = feature, y = gene, fill = present)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white") +
  facet_grid(destination ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "grey90", "TRUE" = "#207a72")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0)) +
  labs(x = "Sequence feature", y = NULL, fill = "Present",
       caption = paste("Source:", data_source, "release", data_release))
```
